module_summary: Credit counter: a single up/down count register incremented on give and decremented on take, with comparators reporting credits left, critical and full.

anchors.name: credit_q
anchors.why: Credit count register updated by give/take, compared for status outputs

anchors.name: credit_give_i
anchors.why: Returns a credit; increments counter when no simultaneous take

anchors.name: credit_take_i
anchors.why: Consumes a credit; decrements counter when no simultaneous give

anchors.name: credit_o
anchors.why: Current credit count output copied from credit_q

anchors.name: credit_left_o
anchors.why: Asserted when at least one credit remains

anchors.name: credit_full_o
anchors.why: Asserted when credit count equals NumCredits

anchors.name: credit_crit_o
anchors.why: Asserted when one more give would fill the credits

anchors.name: increment
anchors.why: Increment enable for credit_d from give without take

anchors.name: decrement
anchors.why: Decrement enable for credit_d from take without give

groups.name: credit_count
groups.description: Up/down credit counter with synchronous clear to initial credits

groups.name: credit_status
groups.description: Comparators reporting count, left, critical and full status
